quranTranslation.text: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.

explanation.bs: „…i da obavljaju namaz i daju zekat; to je ispravna vjera“ – zekat kao temelj vjere.
explanation.en: “…to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion” — zakat as a pillar of the faith.

quranTranslation.text: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,

explanation.bs: O Jahji: „te čistotu (زَكَاة)“ od Nas – mufesiri: čistoća, dobročinstvo; neki: milostinja.
explanation.en: Of John: “and purity (زَكَاة)” from Us — mufassirun: purity, righteousness; some: charity.

quranTranslation.text: The alms are only for the poor and the needy, and those who collect them, and those whose hearts are to be reconciled, and to free the captives and the debtors, and for the cause of Allah, and (for) the wayfarer; a duty imposed by Allah. Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „Sadake (الصَّدَقَات) su samo za siromahe…“ – većina mufesira: ovdje je riječ o obaveznom zekatu.
explanation.en: “The alms (الصَّدَقَات) are only for the poor…” — most mufassirun: here the obligatory zakat is meant.

quranTranslation.text: Take alms of their wealth, wherewith thou mayst purify them and mayst make them grow, and pray for them. Lo! thy prayer is an assuagement for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Uzmi od njihovih imetaka sadaku kojom ćeš ih očistiti i učiniti boljima“ – sadaka koja čisti (tefsir se razilazi je li to zekat ili sadaka kao iskup); uz nju i glagol korijena zekata.
explanation.en: “Take alms of their wealth, wherewith thou mayst purify them and mayst make them grow” — charity that cleanses (tafsir differs: zakat, or an expiatory charity); a verb of zakat's root beside it.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „Ne poništavajte svoje sadake prigovaranjem i uznemiravanjem“ – dobrovoljna sadaka i njena pravila.
explanation.en: “Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury” — voluntary charity and its manners.

quranTranslation.text: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;

explanation.bs: Bogobojazni „od onoga čime smo ih opskrbili udjeljuju“ – udjeljivanje uz vjeru i namaz.
explanation.en: The righteous “spend of that We have bestowed upon them” — spending beside faith and prayer.

quranTranslation.text: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.

explanation.bs: „Neka onaj ko ima obilje troši iz svog obilja“ – trošenje na porodicu, ne milostinja.
explanation.en: “Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance” — spending on one's family, not alms.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who disbelieve spend their wealth in order that they may debar (men) from the way of Allah. They will spend it, then it will become an anguish for them, then they will be conquered. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto hell,

explanation.bs: „Oni koji ne vjeruju troše svoje imetke da bi odvraćali od Allahova puta“ – ista riječ za trošenje protiv vjere.
explanation.en: “Those who disbelieve spend their wealth in order that they may debar (men) from the way of Allah” — the same word for spending against the faith.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!

explanation.bs: Musa: „Tražim utočište kod Allaha od toga da budem od neznalica“ – ar-Rāġib: podsmijeh kao neznanje.
explanation.en: Moses: “Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish [the ignorant]!” — ar-Rāġib: mockery as ignorance.

quranTranslation.text: (Alms are) for the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.

explanation.bs: „Onaj ko ne zna (الْجَاهِل) smatra ih imućnim zbog njihove suzdržanosti“ – neznalica bez prijekora.
explanation.en: “The unthinking man [الْجَاهِل, the one who does not know] accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint” — the ignorant without blame.

quranTranslation.text: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;

explanation.bs: „…a kad im se neznalice obrate, odgovore: Mir“ – neznanje kao grubo ponašanje.
explanation.en: “…and when the foolish ones (الْجَاهِلُونَ) address them answer: Peace” — ignorance as rude behaviour.

quranTranslation.text: Give not unto the foolish (what is in) your (keeping of their) wealth, which Allah hath given you to maintain; but feed and clothe them from it, and speak kindly unto them.

explanation.bs: „I ne dajite nerazboritima (السُّفَهَاء) svoje imetke“ – nerazboritost u imetku.
explanation.en: “Give not unto the foolish (السُّفَهَاء) your wealth” — unsoundness in handling wealth.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.

explanation.bs: „Zar da vjerujemo kao što su povjerovali bezumnici? Zaista, upravo su oni bezumnici“ – optužba vraćena licemjerima.
explanation.en: “Shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish?” — the charge turned back on the hypocrites.

quranTranslation.text: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

explanation.bs: Džini: „Naš je bezumnik o Allahu govorio ono što prelazi svaku mjeru“ – lakoumnost u vjeri.
explanation.en: The jinn: “the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie” — foolishness in religion.

quranTranslation.text: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!

explanation.bs: „Gubitnici su, doista, oni koji će na Sudnjem danu izgubiti same sebe i svoje porodice. Eto, to je očit gubitak!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations.

explanation.bs: „A oni čije vage budu lake – to su oni koji su sami sebe izgubili.“
explanation.en: “And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls.”

quranTranslation.text: They indeed are losers who deny their meeting with Allah until, when the Hour cometh on them suddenly, they cry: Alas for us, that we neglected it! They bear upon their backs their burdens. Ah, evil is that which they bear!

explanation.bs: „Na gubitku su, zaista, oni koji poriču susret s Allahom.“
explanation.en: “They indeed are losers who deny their meeting with Allah.”

quranTranslation.text: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;

explanation.bs: „I tražili su pobjedu, a razočaran ostade svaki tvrdoglavi silnik“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

explanation.bs: „A bez uspjeha ostaje onaj ko je zaprlja (dušu)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.

explanation.bs: Musa vračarima: „Ne izmišljajte laž o Allahu … a bez uspjeha je ostao ko god izmišlja.“
explanation.en: Moses to the magicians: “Invent not a lie against Allah … He who lieth faileth miserably.”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you, how a people were minded to stretch out their hands against you but He withheld their hands from you; and keep your duty to Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust.

explanation.bs: „… kad su neki ljudi naumili da prema vama pruže ruke svoje, pa je On ruke njihove od vas zaustavio“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… how a people were minded to stretch out their hands against you but He withheld their hands from you” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to intend, to be about to

quranTranslation.text: They swear by Allah that they said nothing (wrong), yet they did say the word of disbelief, and did disbelieve after their Surrender (to Allah). And they purposed that which they could not attain, and they sought revenge only that Allah by His messenger should enrich them of His bounty. If they repent it will be better for them; and if they turn away, Allah will afflict them with a painful doom in the world and the Hereafter, and they have no protecting friend nor helper in the earth.

explanation.bs: „… i naumiše ono što nisu postigli“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… And they purposed that which they could not attain” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to intend, to be about to

quranTranslation.text: When two parties of you almost fell away, and Allah was their Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust.

explanation.bs: „Kad su dvije skupine među vama naumile da posustanu, a Allah im je bio Zaštitnik“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “When two parties of you almost fell away, and Allah was their Protecting Friend” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to intend, to be about to

quranTranslation.text: It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah. Lo! Allah loveth those who put their trust (in Him).

explanation.bs: „… i savjetuj se s njima o stvari. A kad se odlučiš, onda se osloni na Allaha“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And if they decide upon divorce (let them remember that) Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „A ako čvrsto odluče da se razvedu – Allah, doista, sve čuje i zna“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And if they decide upon divorce (let them remember that) Allah is Hearer, Knower” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: There is no sin for you in that which ye proclaim or hide in your minds concerning your troth with women. Allah knoweth that ye will remember them. But plight not your troth with women except by uttering a recognised form of words. And do not consummate the marriage until (the term) prescribed is run. Know that Allah knoweth what is in your minds, so beware of Him; and know that Allah is Forgiving, Clement.

explanation.bs: „I nemojte se odlučiti na bračnu vezu dok propisani rok ne istekne“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Do not resolve on the knot of marriage “until (the term) prescribed is run” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you.

explanation.bs: „Koliko ste boravili?“ Rekoše: „Boravili smo dan ili dio dana“ – mladići pećine pitaju o trajanju; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day” — the youths of the cave ask about the length; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to tarry, to remain (for a span)

quranTranslation.text: And verily we sent Noah (as Our messenger) unto his folk, and he continued with them for a thousand years save fifty years; and the flood engulfed them, for they were wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „… pa je među njima boravio hiljadu godina bez pedeset“ – Nuhov boravak izmjeren; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And he continued with them for a thousand years save fifty years” — Noah's stay, measured; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to tarry, to remain (for a span)

quranTranslation.text: And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news. They said: Peace! He answered: Peace! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf.

explanation.bs: „… i nije odugovlačio, nego je donio pečeno tele“ – Ibrahim nije oklijevao da ugosti goste.
explanation.en: “And delayed not to bring a roasted calf” — Abraham did not linger in honouring his guests.

gloss.en: to tarry, to remain (for a span)

quranTranslation.text: Then, when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his housefolk, he saw in the distance a fire and said unto his housefolk: Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire; peradventure I shall bring you tidings thence, or a brand from the fire that ye may warm yourselves.

explanation.bs: Musa porodici: „Zadržite se tu! Opazio sam vatru …“ – ostaju i čekaju ga; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: Moses to his family: “Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire” — they stay and wait for him; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.

explanation.bs: „I nije se dugo zadržao …“ – kratko zadržavanje; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But he was not long in coming” — a short halt; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He sendeth down water from the sky, so that valleys flow according to their measure, and the flood beareth (on its surface) swelling foam - from that which they smelt in the fire in order to make ornaments and tools riseth a foam like unto it - thus Allah coineth (the similitude of) the true and the false. Then, as for the foam, it passeth away as scum upon the banks, while, as for that which is of use to mankind, it remaineth in the earth. Thus Allah coineth the similitudes.

explanation.bs: „… a ono što ljudima koristi ostaje u zemlji“ – ostajanje bez čekanja, protuprimjer.
explanation.en: “As for that which is of use to mankind, it remaineth in the earth” — staying without waiting, a counter-example.

quranTranslation.text: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

explanation.bs: „Onaj koji vam je zemlju učinio posteljom, a nebo zdanjem …“ – ar-Rāġib: učinio ju je pokornom, mjestom na kojem se može nastaniti.
explanation.en: “Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place [a bed, firāš] for you, and the sky a canopy” — ar-Rāġib: He made it tractable, a place one can settle on.

quranTranslation.text: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.

explanation.bs: „Naslonjeni na posteljama čija je postava od debele svile …“ – množina فُرُش: prostrte postelje u Džennetu.
explanation.en: “Reclining upon couches [furush] lined with silk brocade” — the plural فُرُش: spread couches in the Garden.

quranTranslation.text: Have We not made the earth an expanse,

explanation.bs: „Zar zemlju nismo učinili ležištem?“ – pripremljeno, poravnato mjesto; ar-Rāġib navodi riječ mihādan.
explanation.en: “Have We not made the earth an expanse [mihād]” — a prepared, smoothed place; ar-Rāġib cites the word mihādan.

quranTranslation.text: Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.

explanation.bs: „… bit ćete pobijeđeni i sakupljeni u Džehennem – a ružno je to ležište!“ – ista riječ za pripremljeno počivalište, ovdje rečena za Džehennem, kao na još pet mjesta.
explanation.en: “Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.” — the same word for a prepared resting-place, said here of Hell, as in five other places.

quranTranslation.text: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

explanation.bs: „I Allah vam je zemlju učinio prostirkom“ – rasprostrta u širinu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse [bisāṭ] for you” — spread out wide; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
